accepted_findings.finding: Different metadata inputs collide and the actual runtime accepts the tampered integrity record.

The public API has no admission precondition: its exact comparison postcondition is conditional on finite-model admission; the out-of-model external-body fallback promises only a normalized ordering. This is proof-coverage limitation, not an observed comparison bug.

rejected_model_claims: A documented trust boundary and green solver result do not establish absence of meaningful gaps.

The model report assertion of internal consistency is not accepted: an injective mapping from all pairs of u64 values into one u64 is impossible by finite cardinality. Solver success under trusted axioms is not a consistency certificate.
acceptance: No source candidate to integrate. Preserve actual model reports unchanged, including overclaims and all denied calls, with these parent corrections.
